title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page .


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed, if applicable, any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn, or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed.


By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Legal Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!



⚠️Important Application Notice

Please select only the role that best aligns with your experience. We will only review your first application. If you apply to multiple positions on LinkedIn, additional submissions will not be processed and may cause your application to be overlooked.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.


About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.


Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • BYOD required (bring your own device).



At Andela, we know our strengths lie in our diverse community whose talents, perspectives, backgrounds and orientations we take pride in. Andela is committed to nurturing a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Everyone has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits discriminatory practices.

Andela provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to factors including but not limited to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy (including breastfeeding), genetic information, HIV/AIDS or any other medical status, family or parental status, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This commitment applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Our policies expressly prohibit any form of harassment and/or discrimination, as stated above.

Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.


About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.


Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • BYOD required (bring your own device).



At Andela, we know our strengths lie in our diverse community whose talents, perspectives, backgrounds and orientations we take pride in. Andela is committed to nurturing a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Everyone has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits discriminatory practices.

Andela provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to factors including but not limited to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy (including breastfeeding), genetic information, HIV/AIDS or any other medical status, family or parental status, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This commitment applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Our policies expressly prohibit any form of harassment and/or discrimination, as stated above.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Cientista de Dados (IA)
description:
Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados com atuação na implementação de soluções com IA , sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises espaciais.


Formação:

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Júnior – Java & Angular
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Sobre a Vaga


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Contratação: CLT

Prazo: Indeterminado

Horário: Comercial


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Júnior para atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas corporativos, com foco em aprendizado contínuo e evolução técnica.

A pessoa atuará em conjunto com profissionais mais experientes, participando do desenvolvimento de soluções integradas a ERPs, sistemas fiscais e órgãos públicos, com exposição a ambientes de Big Data e aplicações de missão crítica.


Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento back-end em Java e Ruby , com acompanhamento do time.
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento front-end utilizando Angular 7 .
  • Auxiliar na manutenção e consultas em bancos de dados PostgreSQL e Vertica (Big Data) .
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs para integração com sistemas ERP (SAP) .
  • Apoiar em integrações com sistemas fiscais e órgãos públicos (Prefeituras e SEFAZ).
  • Atuar na correção de bugs, melhorias evolutivas e suporte aos sistemas.
  • Seguir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento e documentação.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimentos em Java .
  • Noções de Angular 7 .
  • Conhecimento básico em PostgreSQL .
  • Noções de Ruby .
  • Conhecimento básico em integração via APIs .
  • Interesse em aprender sobre sistemas fiscais , SAP e integrações governamentais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência acadêmica ou profissional com Big Data / Vertica .
  • Conhecimento prévio em sistemas fiscais (NF-e, NFS-e, SEFAZ).
  • Vivência com projetos integrados a ERP SAP .

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.


Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.


We are recruiting hands-on Mechanical / Electrical / HVAC / Facilities generalists with a strong mechanical background to support long-term contractor requirements


Typical Responsibilities

Carry out hands-on work across mechanical / facilities systems, supporting safe, reliable operations.

Interpret engineering drawings to diagnose issues, plan tasks, and verify correct installation/repair.

Support basic troubleshooting across HVAC / electrical interfaces as required for a multi-skilled generalist.

Complete job documentation and communicate clearly in English with site teams and stakeholders.

Follow site safety rules and participate in screening/compliance requirements.


Candidate Profile

Multi-skill background (mechanical-heavy with exposure to electrical/HVAC/facilities).

Previous contractor experience in industrial, energy, manufacturing, or large facilities environments.

Willingness to work in the Balkans region and/or broader Central Asia pipeline locations.


Key Requirements

Mechanical systems experience and ability to read engineering drawings

Strong English (mandatory)

Ability to pass background checks


What We Can Offer

Competitive day rate and standby rate

Accommodation, travel, and food/per diem covered


Compliance / Screening

All candidates must be able to complete a background check.


Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Mechanical Engineer to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
As a Software Engineer , you will work closely with the product owner to shape the implementation of new features/sites. You will collaborate with the PO to write, refine, groom, and plan stories for feature implementation. You will also work with other teams when there are cross-team impacts to ensure integration is seamless and efficient.



Responsibilities

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development.

• Work well in Agile or Lean Software Development Life Cycle.

• Follow InComm standards and best practices, for logging, code review

• Manage and maintain lower environments (QA, UAT, Staging)

• Support production deployments

• Assist with production support, on-call schedule for DEV resources.

• Automate processes through SDLC to permit speed of delivery

• Ensure appropriate monitoring and alerting is in place prior to production deployments.

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development

• Able to quickly adjust and support changing priorities per business needs.

• Provide unit testing to ensure quality of builds in a continuous integration environment.

• Engage in production deployment co-ordination and verification

• Create documentation on the existing system and maintain documentation which includes current state of system flow, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, runbooks

• Participate in the full lifecycle of projects, including effective use of version control, build management, unit testing, and issue tracking software

• Effective verbal and written communication

• Problem solving skills and the ability to work with innovative solutions

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and understand key issues quickly

• Ability to adapt in a dynamic work environment and make independent decisions while keeping management informed

• Work effectively in a team environment to produce good quality and timely results

• Able to work under tight deadlines while providing high-quality work

• Parse, analyze and understand system log files

• Customer Service orientation with the ability to effectively interact with users of all levels

• Able to proactively address system issues that have potential impact for the corporation

• Strong research, analytical, and troubleshooting skills

• Check and verify the applications are running and functioning properly after system updates

• Migration of platforms and application components.

• Support after-hours coverage/escalation & support on-call rotation


Qualifications

• Technologist, Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree

• At least 7 years of Software Development experience

• Experience with the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Maven, Microsoft Visual Studio, JIRA)

• Java 17+

• Spring (data, boot, security, batch and actuator)

• In memory caching like Hazelcast

• Oracle 12c

• XML, JSON

• Hibernate, Hibernate/JPA

• REST Services

• API Management frameworks

• General SQL/Database experience, MS-SQL, Oracle

• Jenkins, Sonar

• JIRA & Confluence

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshoot issues

• Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

title: Desenvolvedor Ruby on Rails
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções tecnológicas para o segmento de serviços, contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.

Experiencia com desenvolvimento com Ruby on Rails (versão 6 ou superior)

PostgreSQL

Sidekiq Redis RSpec ou Minitest

Git

Conhecimento em integração contínua (CI/CD)

Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban)

Experiencia com Docker

Perfil colaborativo, proativo e orientado à entrega de valor

Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações escaláveis em Ruby on Rails

Trabalhar em conjunto para entrega de soluções robustas e eficientes

Propor melhorias técnicas e participar ativamente das decisões de arquitetura

Escrever testes e garantir a qualidade do código


Por que essa vaga pode ser ideal pra você?

Ambiente de aprendizado contínuo e espaço para crescimento

Time comprometido com excelência técnica

Cultura de feedback

Autonomia e respeito

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir o entendimento funcional detalhado junto aos Business Partners (BPs), garantindo total coerência entre a necessidade real do negócio e a solução sistêmica proposta;
  • Converter Histórias de Usuário (HU) em especificações funcionais (FS) e desenhos técnicos (DS) detalhados, contemplando regras de negócio, tratativa de exceções e validações complexas;
  • Elaborar fluxogramas de processos (AS-IS / TO-BE) e modelos em notação BPMN para suportar o entendimento end-to-end das cadeias de valor;
  • Mapear de forma exaustiva as integrações, dados mestres, dependências entre objetos SAP e impactos cruzados entre módulos;
  • Atuar em colaboração direta com Especialistas SAP (ABAP/Integration) e Liderança Técnica para validar a viabilidade e performance das soluções desenhadas;
  • Criar cenários de testes funcionais abrangentes e suportar a execução de testes integrados, smoke tests e homologação de usuário (UAT);
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida da entrega, validando correções, parametrizações e garantindo a qualidade dos transportes até o ambiente de Produção (PRD);
  • Produzir e manter documentação funcional clara, estruturada e aderente aos padrões de governança do programa;
  • Apoiar a governança funcional da TI, zelando pela manutenção de templates, boas práticas e padronização da documentação.


O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência sólida em projetos de implementação ou sustentação de SAP S/4HANA, especificamente no módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management);
  • Experiência comprovada na elaboração de Especificações Funcionais (FS) e Técnicas (DS);
  • Conhecimento prático de processos empresariais end-to-end (OTC, P2P, Logística e Integração com Balança/Armazenagem);
  • Domínio de SAP S/4HANA (Módulo ACM);
  • Interpretação de requisitos em formato BDD (Given/When/Then);
  • Modelagem de processos (BPMN) e ferramentas de diagramação;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de integração SAP (APIs, IDOCs) e sistemas satélites;
  • Metodologia de projeto SAP Activate.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência funcional híbrida (conhecimento em módulos correlatos como SD, MM ou TM);
  • Conhecimento profundo das especificidades do setor de Agronegócio (Commodities, Originação, Fixação);
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e notas SAP.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us

With offices in Latin and North America and Europe, we are present in the industrial routines of the largest companies on the planet! Innovation is in our blood! Our team is leading the way by delivering features companies need to stay competitive. All of this is to improve efficiency and increase productivity for companies by simplifying the SAP asset management process. We deliver data reliability and cost reduction to our partners so that they are increasingly at the top of their game. Be part of our story and lead the digital transformation with us!

We are looking for Customer Success talent with a passion for working in a high growth environment. To help manage our rapid growth, Sigga Technologies is investing in a critical role in Customer Success Management responsible for a unique opportunity to craft our customer success strategies, build strong relationships with a global customer portfolio, and partner with cross-functional Sigga executives. Our ideal candidate is an accomplished problem solver, data driven, and ready to travel worldwide to ensure customer health and drive value to our customers and expansions for Sigga Technologies.


About Us

With offices in Latin and North America and Europe, we are present in the industrial routines of the largest companies on the planet! Innovation is in our blood! Our team is leading the way by delivering features companies need to stay competitive. All of this is to improve efficiency and increase productivity for companies by simplifying the SAP asset management process. We deliver data reliability and cost reduction to our partners so that they are increasingly at the top of their game. Be part of our story and lead the digital transformation with us!

We are looking for Customer Success talent with a passion for working in a high growth environment. To help manage our rapid growth, Sigga Technologies is investing in a critical role in Customer Success Management responsible for a unique opportunity to craft our customer success strategies, build strong relationships with a global customer portfolio, and partner with cross-functional Sigga executives. Our ideal candidate is an accomplished problem solver, data driven, and ready to travel worldwide to ensure customer health and drive value to our customers and expansions for Sigga Technologies.

Objectives for the role

  • Drive product adoption post-implementation, enabling expected ROI attainment for the customer.
  • Set, monitor and achieve measurable outcomes and KPIs set with the customer (success criteria) related to customer value realization and mutual success.
  • Become a trusted, strategic advisor for your customers, willing to dig deep and learn about the direction of their company, goals, and how Sigga can help them achieve them.
  • Be the internal voice of the customer and work cross-functionally within Sigga Technologies to escalate risks and present recommendations & solutions.

What you’ll do

  • Trusted Advisor – Build great customer relationships and set customers up for success by:
  • Understanding goals, strategies, & initiatives and establishing Sigga Technologies as the best-in-class workflow
  • Build trusted relationships with users and leaders to help them achieve their personal and organizational goals
  • Recommending best practices based on understanding customer’s business goals, success criteria for getting value
  • Maintain customer health by developing and executing customer success plans that reflect a holistic path for customers to achieve ROI
  • Outcomes and Risk Management:
  • Drive adoption of Sigga Technologies’ products to enable customers to achieve business value and critical outcomes
  • Measure and monitor KPIs to draw insights and execute actions
  • Own customer lifecycle experience including renewal conversations and exceed cross-sell revenue retention goals
  • Partner with Account manager and share growth opportunities
  • Stay current on Sigga Technologies’ products and services and develop use cases to drive customers to adopt best practice standards.
  • Proactively manage at-risk customers and develop success plans, prevent churn and reduce unnecessary escalations.
  • Expand CSPs to include additional outcomes as customer needs evolve
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to develop customer case studies
  • Build and document new CS processes and procedures including playbooks, process outlines, best practices, engagement strategies, etc.

What we’re looking for

  • Enthusiasm for customer success and excellence, especially within the SaaS space
  • Willingness to learn, collaborative, growth mindset, goal oriented comfortable with ambiguity / changing priorities as part of the start-up culture
  • Proven record of delivering effortless customer experience, and customer-centric internal communications
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to support joint outcomes through customer lifecycles
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively via oral & written formats: PowerPoint and Excel skills are a must, especially with multiple stakeholders/personas
  • Demonstrated creation of data-driven customer action plan strategies

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent time management skills, managing work time responsibly and efficiently
  • Escalation and conflict management skills
  • Ability to be highly collaborative with internal and external teams
  • Independent, critical thinker/problem-resolution skills
  • High accountability to outcomes
  • 5+ years of experience in direct customer engagement roles
  • 3+ years of SAP PM and/or EAM/CMMS experience
  • Strong verbal and written English


Preferred Skills/Abilities

  • 5+ years of account management, customer success, or managed services
  • CRM experience, managing expansion opportunities and customer relationship mapping
  • 3+ years of SAP PM and/or EAM/CMMS experience
  • Microsoft Office/O365 experience

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (B. A.) in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Other

  • Located in Brazil; Hybrid in Belo Horizonte office preferred
  • Willing to travel up to 25% (domestic and international)

  • High accountability to outcomes
  • 5+ years of experience in direct customer engagement roles
  • 3+ years of SAP PM and/or EAM/CMMS experience
  • Strong verbal and written English


Preferred Skills/Abilities

  • 5+ years of account management, customer success, or managed services

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (B. A.) in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Other

  • Located in Brazil; Hybrid in Belo Horizonte office preferred
  • Willing to travel up to 25% (domestic and international)

title: Especialista de Negócios em Geotecnologias
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um profissional sênior e estratégico para atuar na identificação e desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades de negócio, com foco em soluções inovadoras para processos críticos dos nossos clientes e na temática ESG. Se você tem paixão por transformar desafios de mercado em propostas de valor baseadas no uso de geotecnologias, inteligência artifical e analytics, e possui experiência comprovada no ciclo de desenvolvimento de negócios, do insight estratégico à execução das vendas, esta é a sua oportunidade de atuar em uma empresa que usa a tecnologia para transformar negócios e a sociedade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional que aceitar esse desafio será responsável por:

Identificar novas oportunidades estratégicas de crescimento, desenvolver e refinar propostas de valor claras e diferenciadas para entrada em novos segmentos e expansão na nossa base de clientes.

Estruturar e posicionar soluções que enderecem de forma eficaz as demandas e necessidades complexas dos clientes,

Definir tecnicamente a arquitetura e a estrutura das soluções propostas, garantindo alinhamento com a necessidade de negócio do cliente e a viabilidade técnica.

Atuar como interface estratégica com áreas técnicas (Arquitetura e Soluções) para a validação, refinamento e garantia da entrega das soluções e garantindo p engajamento necessário em negociações complexas de serviços que envolvam customizações e/ou integrações.

Realizar o acompanhamento contínuo de tendências tecnológicas, inovações e movimentos do mercado para antecipar necessidades e adaptar o portfólio de soluções.

Apoiar a execução da estratégia de vendas e a evolução do pipeline de oportunidades, produzindo documentos de visão e propostas que sejam aderentes aos problemas de negócio, orçamentos e prazos dos cliente e gerenciando o ciclo de vida do funil, desde a prospecção até o fechamento.

Realizar, no papel de um especialista em tecnologia, apresentações sobre a plataforma Esri e soluções de seus parceiros para clientes e em eventos para o mercado, reforçando a proposta de valor da Imagem.



Requisitos e Qualificações

Experiência Sólida em funções de Business Development, Pré-Vendas, Consultoria Estratégica ou Arquitetura de Soluções, preferencialmente em um contexto B2B e B2G.

Profundo conhecimento e habilidade comprovada em estruturar propostas de valor, modelos de negócio e ofertas técnicas complexas.

Capacidade analítica e estratégica para identificar tendências, analisar dados de mercado e traduzi-los em planos de ação e oportunidades de negócio tangíveis.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, com capacidade de interagir e influenciar executivos e áreas técnicas.

Sólido conhecimento em geotecnologias, especialmente plataforma Esri, e suas aplicações nos diversos mercados.

Inglês Fluente/Avançado;

Espanhol avançado será considerado um diferencial.

Formação:

Superior completo em áreas de Tecnologia (Tecnologia da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia), áreas de Negócios (Economia, Administração) ou em Geociências.

Formação complementar (pós-graduação, MBA ou especialização) em áreas como inovação tecnológica, transformação digital, sustentabilidade, mudanças climáticas ou resiliência ambiental será considerada um diferencial.

description:
O Grupo Zanchetta é referência nacional na Indústria e processamento de aves e bovinos.


Buscamos profissionais para compor nossa equipe de Expedição para nossa unidade na cidade de Batayporã - MS.


Responsabilidades:

•Planejar, organizar e supervisionar as atividades dos setores de paletização, estocagem, expedição e túnel de congelamento.

•Coordenar as operações de expedição, incluindo o carregamento de produtos e roteirização de entrega e alocação e recursos;

title: Analista Sr Infraestrutura AWS e Redes (PJ | Remoto)
description:
Modelo de contratação: PJ

Local: 100% Remoto

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um Analista Sênior de Infraestrutura com forte atuação em Cloud (AWS) e ambientes On‑Premise , com conhecimentos sólidos em Segurança de Redes , Firewalls, Middleware e ambientes de missão crítica. Será responsável por suportar ambientes híbridos, aplicações em microsserviços e produtos Cloud‑native, além de atuar na sustentação, deploys, provisionamento e segurança da infraestrutura.

A atuação envolve contato com equipes de Segurança, DevOps e Integração, além de participação em projetos de desmobilização, melhorias de arquitetura e manutenção de ambientes complexos.


Responsabilidades

  • Administrar, manter e evoluir ambientes AWS e On‑Premise .
  • Realizar atividades relacionadas a segurança de redes , incluindo análise, configuração e troubleshooting de firewalls .
  • Suporte e manutenção em ambientes de infraestrutura em conjunto com as equipes internas.
  • Aplicação de patches de segurança , configurações de rede, provisionamento, acessos e governança de ambientes.
  • Suporte e acompanhamento de ambientes com microsserviços (sobretudo em AWS).
  • Realização de deploys, sustentação de ambientes e apoio à fábrica de integração (MuleSoft e Kafka).
  • Administração e suporte a servidores Linux e Windows (predominância Linux).
  • Colaboração com o time de Segurança para demandas de segurança aplicável (patches, controles, ajustes).
  • Interface com o time de DevOps para discussões técnicas.
  • Suporte de segundo nível, contando com apoio do CSC para atividades de N1.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Forte experiência em Infraestrutura AWS (EC2, VPC, Load Balancers, IAM, Security Groups, CloudWatch etc.).
  • Experiência com ambientes On‑Premise (redes, servidores, virtualização).
  • Domínio em Segurança de Redes , incluindo Firewall e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Conhecimentos em Linux (principal) e Windows Server .
  • Conhecimento de Storage , provisionamento, acessos, e governança.
  • Experiência com aplicação de patches de segurança


  • Desejáveis / Diferenciais
  • Experiência com MuleSoft .
  • Entendimento geral de práticas DevOps .
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de desmobilização/mobilização de sistemas , especialmente envolvendo ERPs.

Essa pessoa terá papel ativo na estabilidade de sistemas produtivos, atuando desde o monitoramento e automação até a análise e resolução de incidentes, sempre em parceria com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança.

  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de ambientes Cloud (AWS, Microsoft Azure e/ou Google Cloud Platform)
  • Administrar e dar suporte a clusters Kubernetes
  • Implementar e manter soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e alertas
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes, realizando troubleshooting em ambientes produtivos
  • Apoiar na definição, acompanhamento e cumprimento de SLAs
  • Automatizar processos operacionais como deploys, rotinas, escalabilidade e correções
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança
  • Propor melhorias contínuas visando maior resiliência, performance e redução de incidentes
  • Atuar em regime de plantão conforme escala 24x7


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos atuando com suporte, SRE, Cloud ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prática com ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP)
  • Conhecimento sólido em Kubernetes e containers (Docker)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, Zabbix, Datadog, New Relic, Elastic, Dynatrace ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas Linux
  • Experiência com troubleshooting de aplicações e infraestrutura
  • Noções de redes, balanceamento de carga e alta disponibilidade
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em plantões em escala 24x7
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e expor ideias


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em pipelines de CI/CD
  • Vivência com práticas e cultura DevOps
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Perfil analítico, proativo, com senso de dono e foco em melhoria contínua
  • Capacidade de lidar com incidentes e situações críticas de forma estruturada

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Suporte Pleno com foco em SRE e Cloud para atuar na sustentação, evolução e confiabilidade de ambientes críticos em nuvem. Essa pessoa terá papel ativo na estabilidade de sistemas produtivos, atuando desde o monitoramento e automação até a análise e resolução de incidentes, sempre em parceria com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de ambientes Cloud (AWS, Microsoft Azure e/ou Google Cloud Platform)
  • Administrar e dar suporte a clusters Kubernetes
  • Implementar e manter soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e alertas
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes, realizando troubleshooting em ambientes produtivos
  • Apoiar na definição, acompanhamento e cumprimento de SLAs
  • Automatizar processos operacionais como deploys, rotinas, escalabilidade e correções
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança
  • Propor melhorias contínuas visando maior resiliência, performance e redução de incidentes
  • Atuar em regime de plantão conforme escala 24x7


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos atuando com suporte, SRE, Cloud ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prática com ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP)
  • Conhecimento sólido em Kubernetes e containers (Docker)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, Zabbix, Datadog, New Relic, Elastic, Dynatrace ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas Linux
  • Experiência com troubleshooting de aplicações e infraestrutura
  • Noções de redes, balanceamento de carga e alta disponibilidade
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em plantões em escala 24x7
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e expor ideias


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em pipelines de CI/CD
  • Vivência com práticas e cultura DevOps
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Perfil analítico, proativo, com senso de dono e foco em melhoria contínua
  • Capacidade de lidar com incidentes e situações críticas de forma estruturada

title: Full Stack Sênior - Node/TypeScript(React)
description:
Sobre a TIVIT | Seu futuro, nosso desafio


A TIVIT é uma multinacional brasileira e one-stop-shop de tecnologia, presente no mercado há 20 anos e com operação em dez países da América Latina. Por meio de quatro unidades de negócios: Digital Business , Cloud Solutions, CyberSecurity e Technology Platforms , a empresa oferece respostas personalizadas e soluções que impactam nos negócios, e na rotina de empresas e pessoas.

A companhia conta com uma forte estratégia de inovação, com o TIVIT Labs (hub que apoia as empresas a descobrirem e solucionarem os seus maiores desafios de inovação) e a TIVIT Ventures, braço de aquisição de empresas inovadoras, que já conta com as marcas Stone Age, tbankS, Privally, DevApi, Lambda3, SENSR.IT e XMS.


Entregar valor para as empresas que trabalham conosco é um esforço que exige uma constante coordenação entre todas as partes da TIVIT. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma empresa que entrega serviços e produtos de ponta-a-ponta (da proposta, passando por todo ciclo de vida, à entrega), por isso, ao trabalhar conosco você vai ter contato com profissionais que possuem diversas experiências em projetos e clientes variados


Descrição da posição Full Stack (Node.js/Typescript) - Sênior

  • 100% Remoto / Contratação CLT
  • Buscamos uma pessoa que possua perfil de liderança, com pelo menos 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, que será referência técnica dentro do time de projeto e apoiará no dia a dia no contato com o cliente. Além disso, esta pessoa precisa estar disposta a aprender e ensinar em todos os momentos, sair da zona de conforto e que possam contribuir com times auto gerenciáveis.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar desde a ideação e concepção de produtos e serviços, até sua entrega e sustentação;
  • Fazer escolhas e/ou discussões das tecnologias que serão empregadas em projetos;
  • Participar e contribuir com projetos que utilizam metodologias de entrega ágil, integração contínua e desenvolvimento guiado por testes (TDD ), comportamento (BDD ), técnicas de modelagem e pair programming;
  • Contribuir com a evolução dos nossos projetos sendo parte de um time de alta performance que atua diretamente com empresas de relevância nacional e internacional.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior completo ;
  • Perfil com foco em BackEnd
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento utilizando NodeJS com NestJS;
  • Experiência com Javascript e Typescript (mais Typescript do que JS puro);
  • Sólido conhecimento em JavaScript, HTML, CSS e princípios de desenvolvimento front-end.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento guiado por testes (TDD ) e comportamento (BDD )
  • Capacidade de criar componentes reutilizáveis e manter código limpo e escalável.
  • Experiência com React.js ;
  • Experiência com Azure Cloud;
  • Container Apps;
  • Function Apps;
  • Observabilidade com Service Bus;
  • Event Hub;
  • Blob Storage;
  • Azure Cosmos Db (Mongo Db);
  • Azure Database (PostgresSQL);
  • Azure DevOps;
  • Azure Pipelines (para CI/CD);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD
  • ELK (monitoramento);
  • Elasticsearch;
  • APM;
  • Prática com estratégias de branch
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura limpa e/ou arquitetura hexagonal
  • Experiência com SOLID
  • Experiência com Microservices
  • Mensageria (Kafka,RabbitMQ );
  • Git;


Experiências técnicas desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Padrões/design de Software
  • Conhecimento em frameworks e bibliotecas relacionadas, como React Router, Material-UI, ou Styled Components,


O que oferecemos para você?

✔Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

✔Assistência médica e Odontológica;

✔Convênio Farmácia (descontos na compra de medicamentos);

✔Seguro de Vida;

✔Convênio Academia;

✔TIVIT Club (descontos e parcerias com as melhores lojas);

✔PAC - Programa de aceleração de carreira;

✔Reembolso para certificações;

✔MOBIFLIX – Nossa academia corporativa tem cursos presenciais e online, alinhados as novas tendências do mercado de tecnologia;

✔Plataforma online de crédito consignado, a TIVIT te ajuda a realizar os seus objetivos pessoais como reforma no seu apê/casa, financiar estudos e quitar dívidas, de acordo com as regras e políticas da cia;

✔Programa de Apoio Pessoal com orientação psicológica, financeira e jurídica em parceria com a Alelo.


Acreditamos que o presente é plural e a inclusão transforma, por isso, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas em nossas vagas, para promovermos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, de respeito, justiça e equidade.

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Executive Assistant | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting an Executive Assistant to join a fast-paced, dynamic international scaleup , supporting the CEO and Founder.


In this role, you will work remotely as a strategic partner to leadership. This is an ideal position for a proactive, organized professional looking to work closely with C-level management in a global environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Operational Excellence: efficiently manage complex calendars, international travel logistics, and inbox triage to ensure the CEO’s day-to-day runs smoothly.
  • Strategic Support: act as a partner to the CEO by leading ad-hoc business projects, conducting market research, and preparing briefing materials to support decision-making.
  • Communication & Reporting: prepare high-quality presentations (decks), reports, and meeting minutes for board meetings and internal strategy sessions.
  • Force Multiplier: facilitate cross-functional communication and handle operational roadblocks, allowing leadership to focus on high-impact strategy.


Requirements:

  • Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Tech-savvy: proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and productivity tools like Notion. Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively to increase efficiency is highly valued.
  • Proactive mindset: you are a problem solver who addresses issues before they become emergencies.
  • High emotional intelligence and professional discretion.


What We Offer:

  • 100% remote, home-office flexibility.
  • Direct exposure to C-Level leadership and business operations.
  • Growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling international company.


How to Apply: Please complete our initial screening form here:


Note: Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: Engineer Informatica IICS
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Data Engineer Sênior


Required experience

• Recommended experience: 5-7 years of hands-on BI application development experience

• Ability to identify technical, security risks and propose mitigation actions

• Hands on experience of Configuration & Release Management Practices

• Participate in software modification during integration testing

• Understand requirements from the stakeholders and documenting such requirements under guidance

• Propose changes to improve efficiency and/or reduce operation or maintenance cost;

• Create good practices and propose improvements

• Gather functional and non functional, including information security requirements from the stakeholders and

document such requirements

Mandatory Skills

• Strong ETL / ELT development experience

* Informatica IICS (design, development, monitoring, optimization)

• Advanced SQL (SQL Server) for data transformation and performance tuning

• MS SSIS for data integration and legacy pipeline support

• Power BI (Semantic modeling, DAX, Performance optimization)

• Data Modeling (Conceptual, logical, and physical models)

• Dimensional modeling (star / snowflake schemas)

• Azure Cloud Data Services (Azure Data Lake (ADLS Gen2), Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics,

Azure Functions, Azure Key Vault)

• Databricks (Pipeline development, Notebooks (Python and/or Scala), Spark optimization and cost/performance

tuning)

• Distributed data architectures and large-scale data processing

• Strong understanding of data formats (Parquet, Avro, JSON)

• CI/CD & DevOps for data platforms (Azure DevOps, Git (branching, version control, deployments))

• Agile/Scrum development methodologies

• Data governance concepts (Data quality, Lineage, Security and access control)

• Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, including (Data preparation for models, Interpreting model outputs)

• Excellent communication skills in English.

Recommended Skills

• Excellent Communication: Ability to interact effectively with international teams, business, and IT Knowledge of

the industrial, automotive, or logistics sectors.

• Experience working with European teams.

• Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure Functions and Azure Web Apps.

• Background in API integrations and JSON-based messaging.

Soft skills

• Strategic mindset with the ability to align technical solutions to business objectives.

• Strong leadership and mentoring skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication, with a collaborative approach.

• Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working in fast-paced environments.

Degree

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.


CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Técnico de suporte
description:
Vaga de Técnico de Sustentação em nossa unidade de negócios de Supply Chain. Oportunidade de suporte , para trabalhar com o software Warehouse Advantage, Infios One (WMS) e com conjunto de softwares de terceiros, como: Sistema operacional Windows, SQL Server/Oracle, software de relatórios e impressões


Responsabilidades no día a día:

Atender usuários por telefone, e-mail ou tickets abertos nas ferramentas usadas pela empresa

Aplicar soluções consultivas e auxiliar na análise de problemas

Garantir a qualidade dos serviços prestados e atingimento do nível de serviço/satisfação acordado.

Consultar as documentações técnicas e fontes alternativas de informação, simulando/testando problemas no ambiente


Qualificação requeridas:


  • 2 anos de experiência em suporte técnico ao cliente
  • Superior Completo ou cursando a partir do 3º semestre em Ciências da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento básico em banco de dados.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais Windows e conceitos de rede
  • Perfil analítico, comunicativo, voltado para resolução de problemas
  • Fortes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente e capacidade de multitarefa
  • Capacidade de priorizar tarefas e auto gerenciá-las
  • Conhecimento básico em lógica de programação


Diferencial:


  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol.
  • Conhecimento em logística (WMS)
  • Experiência com programação de computadores e conhecimento básico de linguagens de programação de computadores
  • Experiência com sistemas operacionais e rede de computadores
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em soluções de gerenciamento da cadeia de suprimentos
  • Experiência com a plataforma Korber One e os aplicativos K.Motion Warehouse Advantage

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno XR / Unity / Godot
description:
A T-Systems, multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom, busca Desenvolvedor Pleno XR / Unity / Godot com bom nível de idioma inglês para atuar na criação de soluções imersivas corporativas, utilizando AR, VR e MR, em projetos inovadores que conectam tecnologia, experiência do usuário e eficiência operacional.

Atuação 100% remota!



O que esperamos de você:

• 3+ anos de experiência com Unity e/ou Godot

• 2+ anos de experiência em um tópico específico como shaders, motion ou multiplayer

• Primeira experiência com VR / XR

• Interesse em tecnologias imersivas e inovação

• Inglês para atuação em ambiente internacional



O que você vai fazer:

• Projetar e desenvolver soluções XR para aplicações enterprise, do conceito à entrega

• Trabalhar com AR, VR e MR em experiências imersivas de alto impacto

• Colaborar com product managers, designers, engenheiros e stakeholders de negócio

• Prototipar rapidamente novos conceitos XR e avaliar tecnologias emergentes

• Otimizar performance para diferentes hardwares, garantindo qualidade visual e usabilidade

• Acompanhar tendências, ferramentas e frameworks de XR para evoluir continuamente as soluções



Por que se juntar a nós:

• Atuar em projetos XR de ponta no contexto enterprise

• Trabalhar em um time moderno, colaborativo e multidisciplinar

• Ter espaço para inovação, experimentação e aprendizado contínuo

• Crescimento técnico em XR, performance e tecnologias emergentes



Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, colaboração e desafios internacionais, essa é a sua chance de acelerar sua carreira!



Candidate-se agora e venha desenvolver o futuro com a gente!
